title: Building Individual Cohorts with outcomePhenotypeTpl()
text: Categories share condition/observation domain can legitimately overlap (e.g. code used H). resolveConceptSetOverlaps() applies fixed precedence rules (> > H > E > {S, C}) concept never counts toward two categories :
code: resolved <- resolveConceptSetOverlaps(   cs_I = afib_I, cs_H = afib_H, cs_S = afib_S, cs_D = afib_D,   cs_T = afib_T, cs_C = afib_C, cs_A = afib_A, cs_E = afib_E )

what: Step 2: resolve exit strategy and demographics
title: Building Individual Cohorts with outcomePhenotypeTpl()
text: resolvePhenotypeExitStrategy() turns clinicalCourse (plus optional overrides) era-collapse gap Capr end strategy. greateDemographicCriteria() builds optional age/gender entry criteria:
code: exitConfig <- resolvePhenotypeExitStrategy(   clinicalCourse = "persistent_transient",   minimumInterepisodeDayGap = 180 )  demographicCriteria <- greateDemographicCriteria(minAge = 18, male = FALSE, female = FALSE)

what: Step 3: build a single cohort variant with outcomePhenotypeTpl()
title: Building Individual Cohorts with outcomePhenotypeTpl()
text: outcomePhenotypeTpl() standard template used batch builders. Called directly, produces one Capr cohort exactly evidence flags pass — , hospitalized, symptom/diagnostic + treatment/follow-variant alternative-diagnosis exclusion: second, looser variant — index H, hospitalization requirement, “least 2 4” evidence components (via evidenceThreshold, see combination vignette) instead strict /rule :
code: afibStrict <- outcomePhenotypeTpl(   cs_I = resolved$cs_I, cs_H = resolved$cs_H, cs_S = resolved$cs_S,   cs_D = resolved$cs_D, cs_T = resolved$cs_T, cs_C = resolved$cs_C,   cs_A = resolved$cs_A, cs_E = resolved$cs_E,   phenotypeLabel = phenotypeLabel,   templateSuffix = "strict-hosp-Aexcl",   useHypernymAsIndex = FALSE,   hasDescreteRecordedSymptoms = TRUE,   requiresDiagnosticTestOrProcedure = TRUE,   requiresActiveTreatmentWithin30d = TRUE,   expectsConditionSpecificFollowupOrSequelae1yr = TRUE,   treatmentFollowUpOp = "all",   excludeA = TRUE,   requiresHospitalization = TRUE,   demographicCriteria = demographicCriteria,   eraDays = exitConfig$eraDays,   endStrategy = exitConfig$endStrategy ) afibLoose <- outcomePhenotypeTpl(   cs_I = resolved$cs_I, cs_H = resolved$cs_H, cs_S = resolved$cs_S,   cs_D = resolved$cs_D, cs_T = resolved$cs_T, cs_C = resolved$cs_C,   cs_A = resolved$cs_A, cs_E = resolved$cs_E,   phenotypeLabel = phenotypeLabel,   templateSuffix = "loose-IH-atLeast2",   useHypernymAsIndex = TRUE,   hasDescreteRecordedSymptoms = TRUE,   requiresDiagnosticTestOrProcedure = TRUE,   requiresActiveTreatmentWithin30d = TRUE,   expectsConditionSpecificFollowupOrSequelae1yr = TRUE,   evidenceThreshold = 2,   excludeA = FALSE,   requiresHospitalization = FALSE,   demographicCriteria = demographicCriteria,   eraDays = exitConfig$eraDays,   endStrategy = exitConfig$endStrategy )

inclusion_rule_mask\r\n  from #best_events Q\r\n  LEFT JOIN #inclusion_events I on q.person_id = i.person_id and q.event_id = i.event_id\r\n  GROUP BY Q.person_id, Q.event_id\r\n) MG -- matching
